request.spec:
The sheet has notes: a text and an add button (NOTE_ADDED text=<text>; a blank note is refused with
an error beside the entry). Show the notes newest first as <sheet's today when added> <user>:
<text>. Under an as-of date the list shows the notes added while the sheet's today was on or before
that date.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The sheet has notes: a text and an add button (NOTE_ADDED text=<text>; a blank note is refused with
an error beside the entry). Show the notes newest first as <sheet's today when added> <user>:
<text>. Under an as-of date the list shows the notes added while the sheet's today was on or before
that date.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Sheets now have notes, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

**How it behaves:**
- The notes are listed newest first, each line reading `<sheet's today when added> <user>: <text>`, for example `2026-03-11 uma: third`.
- With an as-of date set, the list only shows notes added while the sheet's today was on or before that date.
- A note's text is trimmed before saving. A blank note shows `note-error` and writes nothing.
- A viewer can't add a note, and nobody can on an archived sheet.
- Each note added writes `NOTE_ADDED sheet=… by=… text=…` to the audit file. When the user is acting for someone through a delegation, the existing audit service adds ` for=<steward>` to the end of the line.

**What I added:**
- **Stored data:** a migration, `V98__sheet_note.sql`, creates a `sheet_note` table holding the text, who added it and the date added.
- **Server:** a new `note` package with endpoints `GET /api/sheets/{sheetId}/notes` (takes an optional `asOf`) and `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/notes`, plus the handler that returns the blank-note error. It follows the same pattern as void reasons.
- **Front end:** `features/notes/` holds the list and the form, with `data-testid`s `note-line`, `note-text`, `note-add` and `note-error`. It sits on the main screen right after the void reasons panel.

Cloning a sheet does not copy its notes, because the request didn't say whether it should.
